subject: how to plot prcomp results using ggplot2?

messages.author: 51af56f8dba6ef19
messages.subject: how to plot prcomp results using ggplot2?
parts:
Hello,

Can anyone please advice how to plot the result of prcomp using ggplot2?

I am interested only in the equivalent of plot:

data.prcomp <- prcomp(~x1+x2+x3,data=data)
plot(data.prcomp) # want ggplot2 instead how?

TIA,
Best regards,
Giovanni

messages.author: 065110cca96a6373
messages.subject: Re: how to plot prcomp results using ggplot2?
parts:
Hi Giovanni,

Well this should not be too conceptually difficult to do, but there
are a fair number of steps involved. Basically, plot methods dispatch
data.prcomp to biplot.prcomp, which eventually passes it off to
biplot.default. The processing at biplot.prcomp needs to be
replicated, and then the graphing from biplot.default duplicated in
ggplot2.

stats:::biplot.prcomp # the source for biplot.prcomp
stats:::biplot.default # source for default method

roughly speaking, this would involve:

geom_text()
geom_segment()

http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/geom_segment.html
http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/geom_text.html

Most of the work is already done in base graphics, but pulling out the
relevant parts and getting data into a format amenable to use with
ggplot2 will be somewhat tedious. I have too many other projects
going on right now to pick this up, but if you decide to work on it
and get stuck, feel free to ask questions. I'm also willing to help
finish and polish it, if you want.

Cheers,

Josh
